versions.changelog:
**Initial content and prompt set added for the Auto Body & Collision Repair Marketing Kit.**

- Added MARKETING.md with marketing kit details
- Added sample use case in examples/precision-collision-las-vegas.md
- Introduced initial prompt library: seasonal campaigns, service pages schema, reputation/referral content, and digital ads/local SEO (4 prompts)
- Added foundational package.json for skill setup
- No changes to core compliance explanations or compliance gates in SKILL.md

- Initial release of the Auto Body & Collision Repair Marketing Kit.
- Generates marketing content for auto body shops, collision repair centers, and PDR operators, specifically tailored for Nevada (Clark County) + Federal compliance.
- Enforces 7 compliance gates to block common EPA, certification, parts, and insurance marketing violations.
- All outputs ensure legally-defensible, accurate claims and required disclosures.
- First tool to automate compliance for auto body marketing content; no other marketing tool enforces these gates.
